title: Ring of scattered dots

techniques.name: Dot record

dot.label: Dot size
dot.note: Radius of every dot, against the page’s own. Held between a dot that still prints and one that still stands apart.

density.label: Density
density.note: Dots per character: more carry the same count at a finer grain, fewer leave it open.

spread.label: Spread
spread.note: How wide each cluster is laid around its point.

reach.label: Reach
reach.note: α, how far a message’s departure from the record’s center carries its cluster out: low lays the crossings on a clean path, high scatters them.

focus.label: In focus
focus.note: How many of the newest exchanges are inked in night as in focus: the page breathes between 4 and 7.

seed.label: Record
seed.note: Deals a new simulated record from the same rules. No. 0 is the page’s own.

techniques.implementation: Every character of a record is one dot; position comes from the model, tone from who wrote it. Drawn by the source page’s own code, with its stipple and the figure’s own constants given dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.
